anti_tuning: Quiet-RV signal parameters, 8-asset universe, holding period, decluster window, and cost proxy copied unchanged from frozen SL-VAL-QUIET-RV-001. No parameter, asset, threshold, holding-period, or cost change after outcomes are opened. Only the price source changes: Binance Spot monthly klines (parent's own source) versus Bybit USDT linear-perpetual public klines, over their overlapping coverage window.

data.venue_a: Binance Spot monthly klines (data.binance.vision) - identical source used by parent SL-VAL-QUIET-RV-001
data.venue_b: Bybit USDT linear-perpetual public V5 kline API (api.bybit.com/v5/market/kline) - price only, no funding/OI

hypothesis: The exact frozen Quiet-RV quiet-regime relative-value signal, computed identically, produces materially consistent OOS event timing/sides and price-return outcomes when fed Bybit linear-perpetual close prices instead of Binance Spot close prices, over their actual overlapping data coverage.

signal.trigger: largest absolute deviation across the 8-asset basket exceeds the strictly-prior pooled 540-bar 90th percentile
signal.direction: fade the deviation (SHORT if positive, LONG if negative)

terminal_gate.support_if: Bybit-sourced OOS10bps mean>0 AND PF>1 AND OOS20bps mean>0 over the common window, AND event-level overlap with the Binance-sourced event set >=70%
terminal_gate.otherwise: portability_verdict in the terminal result payload enumerates the exact failure mode (INCONCLUSIVE / BINANCE-SPECIFIC-CANDIDATE / insufficient venue coverage) - never a bare pass/fail with no reason
